# Skeleton

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:skeleton` · Kerf UI · component · Feedback

## When to use

A subtle, unanimated loading placeholder block for a not-yet-known value slot.

- Stand in for a value that is still loading, on its own or via a component's placeholder prop, keeping the surrounding layout stable.
- Placeholder a custom or free-text slot with the same visual the components' placeholder mode uses.
- Set width and height with typed length builders or finite intrinsic-size keywords; set radius with a typed length.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for known progress or a busy spinner; use LoadingSpinner.
- Do not animate it or use it as decorative filler.
- Do not pass raw CSS strings or cross property grammars into width, height, or radius.

**Alternatives:**

- [Skeleton](./wa-skeleton.md) (prefer-over)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/skeleton` — exports `Skeleton`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/skeleton` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/skeleton.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/skeleton`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiskeleton) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- block
- lines
- labeled
- typed width, height, and radius

**CSS-value props** (typed builders from `@kerfjs/ui/css-values`; raw CSS strings are rejected):

- `width`: size grammar; raw values: forbid; shorthands `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `fit-content`; helpers `px`, `rem`, `em`, `pct`, `space`, `lengthVar`, `calc` — e.g. `width={em(12)}`
- `height`: size grammar; raw values: forbid; shorthands `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `fit-content`; helpers `px`, `rem`, `em`, `pct`, `space`, `lengthVar`, `calc` — e.g. `height={em(1.5)}`
- `radius`: length grammar; raw values: forbid; helpers `px`, `rem`, `em`, `pct`, `space`, `lengthVar`, `calc` — e.g. `radius={px(999)}`

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** loading lifecycle; which slots are unknown; announcing the loading region.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: none (layout role: feedback). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass label to announce it as an image. A component in placeholder mode marks itself aria-busy and disables its own controls.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-skeleton`, `kui-skeleton-lines`.

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-skeleton-radius`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
